syncAlert.failing: Google Calendar sync has been failing. Google may be out of date.
syncAlert.failingSince: Google Calendar sync has been failing since {time} (UTC). Google may be out of date.

states.errorDescription: Please try again. If it keeps happening, reload the page.

signin.title: Sign in
signin.intro: Sign in with your Google account to continue.
signin.unavailable: Sign-in is unavailable right now. Please try again in a moment.

errors.AccessDenied: That Google account isn't allowed to use this app. Sign in with an account the owner has added, or ask them to add yours.
errors.Verification: That sign-in link has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.fallback: Signing in didn't work. Please try again.

syncFailures.retriedHint: The result shows here in a moment.
syncFailures.loadFailed: Sync problems could not be loaded.
syncFailures.none: No sync problems: every booking is up to date in Google.
syncFailures.count: {count, plural, one {# booking could not be synced} other {# bookings could not be synced}}
syncFailures.dead: Stopped after {count} attempts; retry by hand.
syncFailures.deleteFailing: Removing the event from Google keeps failing.
syncFailures.attempts: {count, plural, one {# attempt so far} other {# attempts so far}}

google.title: Google Calendar
google.description: Bookings appear in the Google calendar you choose for each property, and events there can block dates here.
google.disconnectDescription: All syncing stops, for every property. Events already in your Google calendars are left untouched; delete them there if you no longer want them.
google.addProperty: Add a property to choose its calendar.
google.calendarsFailed: Your calendars could not be loaded: {reason}
google.willSyncHint: Its bookings are being sent to the calendar.
google.queued: {count, plural, one {# booking queued.} other {# bookings queued.}}
google.inbound: Block dates for other events there
google.stopDescription: New and changed bookings are no longer sent to Google. Events already in the calendar are left untouched.

returns.denied: Google Calendar was not connected: access was declined.
returns.scope_missing: Google Calendar was not connected: the calendar permission was not granted. Connect again and allow access to your calendars.
returns.unavailable: Connecting Google Calendar is switched off on this server.
returns.error: Google Calendar could not be connected. Please try again.

reasons.revoked: Google no longer allows this app to use your calendar, for example because access was removed in your Google account.
reasons.key_changed: The server's encryption key changed, so the stored Google access can no longer be read.

archive.title: Archive {name}?
archive.description: It disappears from property selectors, but its bookings and finances stay visible. You can restore it at any time.

page.title: Settings
page.description: Your properties and the defaults every new booking starts from.
page.propertiesHint: Changing a default rate or fee affects new bookings only.
page.emptyDescription: Add the place you rent out to start taking bookings.
page.archivedHint: Hidden from property selectors. Their bookings and finances stay visible.

propertyForm.description: Defaults apply to new bookings only. Existing bookings keep their own rates.
propertyForm.name: Name
propertyForm.colorHint: Bookings for this property use it on the calendar.
